PDS04.name: System.IO.Pipelines PipeReader/PipeWriter and SequenceReader
key_ideas: PipeReader exposes buffered data as ReadOnlySequence<byte>.
AdvanceTo(consumed, examined) is the key contract for what was processed and what was inspected.
SequenceReader is a cursor helper over potentially non-contiguous buffers.
PipeWriter writes by GetMemory/GetSpan, Advance and FlushAsync.
Completion/error flows are explicit on PipeReader/PipeWriter.

reading_quality.overall: Overall: medium-high. Pipe API shapes and mental model are clear.
limitations: Small code details should still be checked against source images if exact syntax matters.
